memory_candidates.content: The F-chain V (from neg_orderedPointsExist_is_vbracket 1 fChainPred) is the WRONG V for the backward direction of neg_bracket_is_vbracket. Five dispatches confirmed: (1) fChainPred omits seg_0 (first segment type), (2) Until witnesses may exceed z1, (3) counter-example: bf with seg_0=bot has bf.holds=False but orderedPointsExist 1 fChainPred = True. The correct approach requires Rabinovich's 'Cond_i AND Form_i' construction, which needs COMBINATORIAL bracket conjunction (currently only existential conjunction exists in VecEAClosure.lean). Prepend-based approaches fail due to interval mismatch: rightPart.holds(r0,z1) failing does not imply rightPart.holds(x0,z1) failing for x0 > r0.

VecEAClosure.lean has only EXISTENTIAL bracket conjunction: conj_to_bracket_exists takes two bracket formulas + their holds proofs and produces an existentially-quantified combined bracket. This is NOT combinatorial -- the resulting bracket depends on the specific structure M and witness configuration. The paper's Lemma 5.1 proof needs COMBINATORIAL conjunction: given bf1 : BracketFormula n1 and bf2 : BracketFormula n2, produce bf3 : BracketFormula n3 with bf3.holds <-> bf1.holds AND bf2.holds, independent of M. This is the missing infrastructure for Rabinovich's 'Cond_i AND Form_i' decomposition.
